create or alter function [graph].[GetPathAsJson] ( @segments xml ) returns nvarchar(850) WITH SCHEMABINDING as begin declare @path nvarchar(850)
if @segments is null begin set @path = '' end else begin set @path = ( select JSON_QUERY('["' + V + '"]') as [Key], Name as AssetType from ( select STRING_AGG(STRING_ESCAPE(Val, 'json'), '","') within group(order by P) as V, L, Name from ( select X.p.value('./@level', 'int') as L, X.p.value('./@position', 'int') as P, X.p.value('./@assetTypeId', 'int') as AT, at.name, X.p.value('.', 'nvarchar(250)') as Val from @segments.nodes('path/segment') as X(p) inner join [dbo].[assettype] at on at.id = X.p.value('./@assetTypeId', 'int') ) O group by L, Name ) OO order by L FOR JSON PATH )
if @path is null begin set @path = '[ERROR:KEY_FIELDS_NULL]' end end
return @path end
